description: Real LLM benchmark tasks against fixed commits of external GitHub projects. Workspaces are cloned from GitHub, mutated in isolated copies, and verified with real project behavior/tests.

tasks.title: Commander should suggest visible short options for single-dash typos
tasks.prompt: In the real commander.js codebase, unknown long options already get did-you-mean suggestions from visible long options. A CLI integration also needs single-dash unknown options to suggest visible short options, while still not suggesting hidden short options and without regressing long option suggestions. Update the commander implementation and add focused in-project coverage in tests/help.suggestion.test.js; the new test should explicitly cover a short option typo such as '-o' suggesting '-p'. In that focused short-option test, disable the default help option with helpOption(false) so implicit '-h' is not also a visible candidate. Keep the change scoped to lib/command.js and tests/help.suggestion.test.js only; do not modify lib/suggestSimilar.js. Run the verifier before finishing, using the verifier command exactly as provided.

anti_shortcut_rules: Do not modify lib/suggestSimilar.js; implement the short-option candidate surface in lib/command.js.
Update tests/help.suggestion.test.js with focused short option or single-dash coverage before running the verifier.
The focused test must explicitly include '-o' and '-p', and its test name must include short option, single-dash, or single dash.
Do not claim success until the real in-project Jest verifier passes.

tasks.title: AxiosHeaders.toString should serialize Set-Cookie arrays as repeated header lines
tasks.prompt: In the real Axios codebase, AxiosHeaders.toString() currently serializes array header values through normal string coercion. That comma-merges Set-Cookie arrays, which is not valid for cookies. Update AxiosHeaders.toString() so `set-cookie` array values serialize as repeated `set-cookie: ...` lines, while non-cookie array headers keep the current comma serialization behavior. Add focused unit coverage in tests/unit/axiosHeaders.test.js that asserts concrete Set-Cookie values serialize as separate lines and that a normal Accept array created with `['application/json', 'text/plain']` still serializes exactly as `accept: application/json,text/plain` with no space after the comma. Keep the change scoped to lib/core/AxiosHeaders.js and tests/unit/axiosHeaders.test.js only; do not modify adapters, package metadata, dependency files, docs, or build output. Run the verifier before finishing, using the verifier command exactly as provided.

anti_shortcut_rules: Do not modify package metadata, dependency files, adapters, docs, or build output for this task.
Implement the behavior in lib/core/AxiosHeaders.js, not by changing the hidden verifier or by modifying adapters.
tests/unit/axiosHeaders.test.js must include explicit Set-Cookie toString coverage with concrete cookie values.
Set-Cookie arrays must serialize as repeated header lines; normal non-cookie array headers must retain the existing comma serialization behavior.
The normal array regression test must use application/json and text/plain, and must assert the exact output `accept: application/json,text/plain`.
Do not claim success until the provided verifier passes.
